name: benchmark_scope
description: 作者承认1,050 prompts与10类别仍可能遗漏specialized或高度复杂交互。

name: CAP_aesthetic_bias
description: CAP可能偏好smooth lighting或dynamic camera等polished presentation。

name: CAP_overconfidence
description: 作者观察到MLLM会在ambiguous/edge cases给出过度确定判断。

name: CAP_refusals
description: proprietary MLLMs会拒绝少量视频，原文写refusal rate below 3但未在PDF中补全单位。

name: proprietary_prompt_process
description: 闭源模型generation process不可见，因此prompt-type分析只保留开源模型。

name: temporal_sampling
description: CAP只均匀采8帧；论文未测试短暂事件在帧间遗漏的敏感性。

name: uncertainty_reporting
description: 主/附录的核心比例和ROC-AUC均为点估计，没有seed/task/model层级的不确定性。

name: causal_identification
description: 由失败率推断“training-set mimicry”或“do not really understand”未通过训练数据、表示或干预实验直接识别。

name: standard_validity
description: Key Standards由CS学生与作者制定；未报告physics expert agreement、inter-rater reliability或标准误差分析。

name: multimodality
description: Current scope is text-centric; images, screen recordings, and other modalities are future work.

name: standardized_evaluation
description: Evaluation/environment protocol standardization is future work.

name: data_quality_automation
description: Stronger validation and automated dataset conversion remain future directions.

name: domain_filtered_training
description: Each harness uses a domain-specific subset, constraining cross-domain training claims.

name: sampling_sensitivity
description: Authors leave alternative multipliers and per-dataset effects to future experiments.

name: license_drift
description: Dataset licenses may change and downstream users must re-verify them.

name: reproduction_detail
description: Training hyperparameters, seed value/count, hardware, and checkpoint selection are absent despite the reproducibility statement.

name: statistical_uncertainty
description: Accuracy tables provide point estimates without uncertainty or repeated-run structure.

name: dedicated_limitations_section
description: The PDF has no dedicated Limitations section; Section 6 ends the main text.

name: pinhole_camera_assumption
description: Appendix A assumes an ideal pinhole camera and ignores lens distortion and skew.

name: fronto_parallel_scope
description: Eq. (6) is derived for a fronto-parallel segment; general shapes need not have pixel-wise equality under the same transforms.

name: known_intrinsics_dependency
description: Ray conditioning requires intrinsics; UniDepth v2 is used to estimate them when unavailable.

name: synthetic_camera_proxy
description: Quantitative cross-camera tests use resize/crop perturbations; physical unseen-camera evidence is qualitative TUM-RGBD.

name: reproducibility_detail_gap
description: Seeds, sample counts, sampling ratios, full splits, loss details, and leakage controls are not stated.

name: uncertainty_reporting_gap
description: No error bars, intervals, tests, or seed variance appear in the result objects.

name: premise retrieval ceiling
description: Ground truth outperforms all selectors in Tables 2–3, so some failures arise because necessary lemmas are not retrieved.

name: Lean-auto translation scope
description: Dependent-type-theory features may be out of scope for translation to higher-order logic.

name: unsupported proof reasoning
description: Induction and arithmetic are given as examples of reasoning unsupported by Aesop, Zipperposition, or Duper.

name: proof reconstruction
description: Zipperposition success followed by Duper reconstruction failure is reported as rare, not impossible.

name: training compute
description: Training the large selector costs 6.5 A6000-days.

name: benchmark and deployment coverage
description: Empirical coverage is Mathlib hold-out plus six miniCTX-v2-test splits; no user study or broader IDE adoption evaluation appears.

name: seed, uncertainty, and leakage audit
description: The PDF does not report seeds, repeated-run uncertainty, inferential tests, intervals, or a train/test leakage audit.

name: independent limitations section
description: There is no heading named Limitations; boundaries are embedded in §4.1, §4.2, and the Table 4 explanation.

name: simulation_external_validity
description: Automated conversations are not representative of natural human-AI dialogue; findings are framed as a controlled stress test.

name: narrow_conversation_structure
description: At most one new shard is revealed per turn; the final turn contains all required information; high-level intent is always present in the first turn.

name: minimal_shards
description: Minimal shards may be unrealistic and potentially adversarial.

name: sharded_scoring_advantage
description: Maximum-over-turn scoring gives SHARDED more answer opportunities than FULL, including lucky guesses or memorized answers.

name: analytical_tasks_only
description: The six tasks require analytical solutions; creative writing and other open-ended domains are outside the evidence.

name: english_text_only
description: Other languages and multimodal user or assistant utterances are not tested.

name: regular_context_only
description: The study is not a long-context stress test; most tasks fit within 8k and all within 20k tokens.

name: summary_model_exclusions
description: Phi-4 and OLMo-2-13B are excluded from Summary because of context limits.

name: api_reproducibility
description: Closed API models may be deprecated, preventing exact future reruns.

name: stochastic_reproducibility
description: Ten repetitions leave statistical variance; larger repetition budgets might reveal missed findings.

name: gradual_sharding_selection
description: Gradual sharding uses inherently complex eight-shard source instructions, limiting the two-turn generalization.

name: mechanism_identification
description: Mechanism analyses are observational and task-restricted; the paper often uses 'hypothesize' or 'likely' for causal explanations.

name: summary_metric_length_bias
description: Joint Score is recall-based and favors longer summaries; outputs above 300 words are truncated proportionally before evaluation.

name: translation_metric_scope
description: BLEU may not capture document-level nuances, weakening the translation scope test.

name: model scope
description: 所有正式 theorem 对象是 UHAT；softmax 与 average-hard attention 的 succinctness 未解决。

name: precision assumptions differ by result
description: UHAT upper bounds允许 arbitrary rational weights；RNN comparison 假设 fixed precision。

name: floating-point evaluation order
description: fixed-precision carry-over 依赖确定的 evaluation order；换序需重新核查 associativity-based identities。

name: worst-case counter dependence
description: EXPSPACE hardness 需要编码巨大 counters；无法编码该结构的 subclass 可能有更低 verification complexity。

name: learnability not established
description: succinct representability 不回答这些 UHAT 是否可学习；作者称经验结果 mixed。

name: state-space-model extension underformalized
description: abstract/intro 对 SSM 使用“by extension”，正文没有专门的 SSM 定义、size measure 或 corollary。

name: standalone limitations section
description: 没有独立 Limitations section；边界散布于 §1、footnote 3 和 §6。
